n81d6dd21b75.s: The 29 subjects of the Eleventh Schedule may be entrusted to Panchayats under which Article?
n81d6dd21b75.x: Article 243G lets States entrust the 29 Eleventh Schedule subjects to Panchayats; it is only a menu and transfers nothing automatically.

n5ca3c1a1224.s: Union Finance Commission grants to Panchayats rest on which Article of the Constitution?
n5ca3c1a1224.x: Union Finance Commission grants rest on Article 280; grants from the State Consolidated Fund relate to Article 243H and SFC recommendations.

n2d8dcfa4c9f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 73rd Constitutional Amendment?
o: It made reservation mandatory in Panchayati Raj institutions
It provided for State Finance Commissions
It made the transfer of all 29 Eleventh Schedule subjects mandatory
It provided for a State Election Commission
n2d8dcfa4c9f.x: The 73rd Amendment made reservation, the SFC and the SEC mandatory, but the 29 Eleventh Schedule subjects are optional, since Article 243G says 'may'.

n4eb17277134.s: Under the Fifteenth Finance Commission, the weight given to population (2011) in horizontal devolution was:
n4eb17277134.x: The Fifteenth Finance Commission gave population (2011) a weight of 15 per cent; demographic performance carried 12.5 per cent.

nd60b210abbf.s: Which criterion, weighted 2.5% by the Fifteenth Finance Commission, was dropped by the Sixteenth Finance Commission?
nd60b210abbf.x: The Sixteenth Finance Commission dropped the 2.5% tax and fiscal effort criterion and introduced contribution to GDP with 10%.

nb2addba0a6f.s: Fifteenth Finance Commission grants to rural local bodies (2021-26) were split into tied and untied parts in the ratio:
nb2addba0a6f.x: The Fifteenth Finance Commission gave ₹2.36 lakh crore to rural local bodies, tied and untied in a 60:40 ratio.

nc1b54e53e47.s: The Fourteenth Finance Commission's grant to Panchayats amounted to:
nc1b54e53e47.x: The Fourteenth Finance Commission gave ₹2,00,292 crore to Panchayats out of a total local-body grant of ₹2,87,436 crore; ₹1.18 lakh crore is a wrong figure for it.

n4c2ccbad8f9.s: In practice, the functionaries meant to serve Panchayats mostly report to:
n4c2ccbad8f9.x: Functions are devolved on paper and funds come tied to schemes, while staff continue to report to State line departments.

ncebbb1ee1b3.s: After 1993, a dissolved local body must be re-elected within how long of its dissolution?
ncebbb1ee1b3.x: Local bodies have a five-year term, and elections are held before expiry or within six months of dissolution under the State Election Commission.

n8a9f176bf30.s: The own revenue of Urban Local Bodies in India is only about ____ of GDP.
n8a9f176bf30.x: ULB own-source revenue is only about 0.3% of GDP, although cities produce about 67% of GDP.

n7e90475fc57.s: Which of the following is a parallel arrangement that bypasses elected local bodies?
n7e90475fc57.x: MPLADS, like DRDAs, user groups and SHGs, bypasses elected local bodies; DPCs and MPCs are constitutional planning bodies.

n53f9830a422.s: Under MPLADS, the works recommended by a Member of Parliament are executed by the:
n53f9830a422.x: Under MPLADS the MP only recommends works; the Implementing District Authority executes them, and RTI applies.

n48f89367402.s: Delayed local-body elections can jeopardise Central grants because the Sixteenth Finance Commission links grants to:
n48f89367402.x: The Sixteenth Finance Commission links grants with properly constituted local bodies, audited accounts and timely SFCs, so delayed polls put funds at risk.

nf1fa9f42cae.s: When an elected woman Panchayat representative enters her second term, proxy behaviour by male relatives:
nf1fa9f42cae.x: Proxy ('sarpanch pati') behaviour falls markedly, not rises, when the woman representative enters a second term.

ndbeac93fa41.s: Which committee made the Collector the chairman of the Zilla Parishad?
ndbeac93fa41.x: The Balwantrai Mehta Committee made the Collector the chairman of the Zilla Parishad; later committees split on the Collector's role.

nb3ed9d476ee.s: The Election Commission of India observed its Diamond Jubilee in:
nb3ed9d476ee.x: The Diamond Jubilee was in 2010; the Golden Jubilee was in 2001 and 75 years were completed in 2025.

nindian-polity-25-17.s: The Election Commission of India has been a multi-member body continuously since:
nindian-polity-25-17.x: The ECI has been a three-member body continuously since 1 October 1993; its members are paid like Supreme Court judges.

nfedfafefb28.s: Under the CEC and Other ECs Act, 2023, the Selection Committee recommends names for appointment to the:
nfedfafefb28.x: The Selection Committee, which may pick names outside the Search Committee's shortlist, recommends names to the President for appointment.

nb9413396b7f.s: The Constitution places post-retirement restrictions on the Comptroller and Auditor General under Article:
nb9413396b7f.x: Article 148(4) bars the CAG from further office after retirement; there is no such express bar for retiring Election Commissioners.

n16495e47b08.s: A motion to remove the Chief Election Commissioner, if moved in the Rajya Sabha, needs the signatures of at least:
n16495e47b08.x: The removal motion needs at least 100 Lok Sabha members or 50 Rajya Sabha members.

n5c715ac13fd.s: Which of the following does the Constitution prescribe for members of the Election Commission?
n5c715ac13fd.x: The Constitution provides for appointment by the President but prescribes no qualifications, no term and no post-retirement bar.

n692d7c3902a.s: Strict enforcement of the Model Code of Conduct from 1991 is associated with which Chief Election Commissioner?
n692d7c3902a.x: Strict MCC enforcement (1991), EPIC and removal of partisan police officers belong to the T.N. Seshan era.

new.s: The State Finance Commission is constituted by the Governor every:
new.x: Under Article 243I the Governor constitutes the SFC every five years.

new.s: Under Article 243Y, the State Finance Commission also reviews the finances of:
new.x: Article 243I covers panchayat finances; Article 243Y makes the same SFC review municipal finances.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the State Finance Commission:
1. It is constituted by the President under Article 280.
2. It advises the Governor on the assignment of State taxes and grants-in-aid to local bodies.
3. The Governor lays its report, with an explanatory memorandum, before the State Legislature.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 2 and 3 are correct. The SFC is constituted by the Governor under Article 243I; Article 280 and the President relate to the Union Finance Commission.

new.s: Who chaired Andhra Pradesh's Fifth State Finance Commission (2025-30)?
new.x: Prof. S. Rathna Kumari chaired AP's 5th SFC, whose report went to the Governor in December 2024; Prof. G. Nancharaiah chaired the 4th SFC.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's first State Finance Commission after bifurcation was the:
new.x: The 4th SFC under Prof. G. Nancharaiah (report 30 October 2019) was the first after bifurcation.

new.s: The Local Finance Enquiry Committee functioned during:
new.x: The Local Finance Enquiry Committee (P.K. Wattal) sat in 1949-51; the Taxation Enquiry Commission followed in 1953-54.

new.s: The Rural-Urban Relationship Committee (1963-66) was chaired by:
new.x: A.P. Jain chaired the Rural-Urban Relationship Committee of 1963-66; P.K. Wattal is linked with the Local Finance Enquiry Committee.

new.s: Which body (1953-54) recommended that some taxes be reserved for local bodies?
new.x: The Taxation Enquiry Commission of 1953-54 recommended reserving some taxes for local bodies.

new.s: Article 280(3)(bb) and (c), on augmenting a State's Consolidated Fund for local bodies, were added in:
new.x: Clauses (bb) and (c) of Article 280(3) were added in 1992 by the 73rd and 74th Amendments.

new.s: Under Article 280(3)(bb), the Union Finance Commission suggests measures to augment State funds for panchayats on the basis of recommendations of the:
new.x: The Union FC's suggestions under Article 280(3)(bb) for panchayats and (c) for municipalities are based on SFC recommendations.

new.s: Under the AP Panchayat Raj Act, 1994, the surcharge on stamp duty that goes to the local body is called:
new.x: Transfer duty, a surcharge on stamp duty (s. 69), goes to the local body; seigniorage fees on quarried materials go to the GP Fund.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, seigniorage fees on materials quarried in a village go to the:
new.x: Under the AP Panchayat Raj Act, 1994, seigniorage fees go to the GP Fund, and a GP may add a surcharge on seigniorage (s. 60(4)).

new.s: The major own revenue of panchayats is:
new.x: Property (house) tax is the major own-source revenue of panchayats (APPSC GS 2018), as it is for ULBs.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Panchayat revenue?
o: Panchayats have an independent constitutional taxing power
Assigned taxes are State-levied taxes handed over on SFC advice
Union Finance Commission grants are routed through the States
Own taxes may be levied only if the State Legislature authorises
new.x: Panchayats have no independent constitutional taxing power; they may levy taxes only when the State Legislature authorises under Article 243H.

new.s: The Fifteenth Finance Commission cut the States' share of the divisible pool from 42% to 41% because:
o: Jammu and Kashmir became a Union Territory
Cesses were added to the divisible pool
new.x: The 15th FC reduced the share to 41% because Jammu and Kashmir became a Union Territory.

new.s: Who chaired the Fourteenth Finance Commission?
new.x: Y.V. Reddy chaired the 14th FC (constituted 2 January 2013), which raised the States' share to 42%.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about vertical devolution:
1. The Fourteenth Finance Commission raised the States' share to 42%.
2. The 41% figure of the Fifteenth Finance Commission is the share of local bodies.
3. The Sixteenth Finance Commission retained the States' share at 41%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. The 41% figure is the States' share of the divisible pool, not the local bodies' share.

new.s: Under the Sixteenth Finance Commission, Andhra Pradesh's share in tax devolution is:
new.x: AP's share rose to 4.217% from 4.05%; all five southern States gained.

new.s: For the Sixteenth Finance Commission, demographic performance is measured by:
new.x: The 16th FC measures demographic performance by population growth 1971-2011; the 15th FC used change in TFR.

new.s: Under the Fourteenth Finance Commission, the basic-to-performance grant ratio for municipalities was:
new.x: The 14th FC used 80:20 for municipalities (APPSC GS 2019) and 90:10 for Gram Panchayats.

new.s: Under the Sixteenth Finance Commission (2026-31), Andhra Pradesh's local-body grants amount to:
new.x: AP gets ₹28,785 crore of local-body grants, of which ₹12,150 crore is tied to holding local polls.

new.s: The bonds issued by the Greater Visakhapatnam Municipal Corporation in December 2018 raised:
new.x: GVMC raised ₹80 crore at 10% in December 2018 through BSE-listed municipal bonds.

new.s: The RBI Report on Municipal Finances (November 2024) put municipal corporations' revenue in 2023-24 at about:
new.x: The RBI report put corporations' revenue at 0.6% of GDP, found bonds negligible and urged GIS mapping for property tax.

new.s: Under the AP State Audit Act, 1989, the Local Fund Audit Department was renamed the:
new.x: The Act renamed the Local Fund Audit Department as the State Audit Department, headed by the Director of State Audit.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the officer who audits local bodies and may levy a surcharge for losses is the:
new.x: The Director of State Audit (Finance Department) audits local bodies and can levy a surcharge for losses under s. 10; the CAG gives only technical guidance.

new.s: Which State ranked first overall in the 2024 Devolution Index released in February 2025?
new.x: Karnataka ranked first, followed by Kerala and Tamil Nadu.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the 2024 Devolution Index:
1. It is prepared by the Ministry of Panchayati Raj with IIPA.
2. It measures six dimensions, including Capacity Enhancement and Accountability.
3. Andhra Pradesh scored 54.43, in the medium band.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: All three are correct: the Index is by MoPR with IIPA, not NITI Aayog, has six dimensions, and AP scored 54.43.

new.s: In the 2024 Devolution Index, which State topped the Functionaries dimension?
new.x: Tamil Nadu topped Functions, Karnataka Finances and Gujarat Functionaries.

new.s: A State Election Commissioner can be removed only in the manner of a:
new.x: Under Articles 243K/243ZA the SEC is removed like a High Court judge; the CEC is removed like a Supreme Court judge.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's ₹12,150 crore of Sixteenth Finance Commission grants is at risk mainly because of:
new.x: AP Mandal and Zilla Parishad polls were due by 23 September 2026, and ₹12,150 crore of grants is tied to holding local polls.

new.s: The AP Cabinet decision of 18 August 2026 provided ____ reservation for Backward Classes in urban local bodies.
new.x: The decision gave BCs 34% in rural and 33⅓% in urban local bodies, along with direct election of Mayors and chairpersons.

new.s: The MoPR advisory committee on proxy representation of women (2025), which suggested exemplary penalties, was headed by:
new.x: The Sushil Kumar committee (2025) of MoPR recommended exemplary penalties for proven proxy cases.

new.s: Sixteenth Finance Commission local-body grants are divided between basic and performance grants in the ratio:
new.x: The 16th FC splits its local-body grants 80% basic and 20% performance.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, local bodies whose elected term has lapsed are run by:
new.x: Special Officers run lapsed local bodies in AP, a form of bureaucratic control.

new.s: The National Institute of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj (NIRDPR) is located at:
new.x: NIRDPR, the national training body for rural development and Panchayati Raj, is at Hyderabad.

new.s: Which e-governance tool is used for the online audit of Panchayat accounts?
new.x: AuditOnline handles online audit; eGramSwaraj is for planning, accounting and reporting.

new.s: Which State has an Ombudsman for Local Self Government Institutions under a 2001 amendment of its Panchayat Raj Act?
new.x: Kerala created the Ombudsman for Local Self Government Institutions through the 2001 amendment of the Kerala Panchayat Raj Act.

new.s: The V. Ramachandran Expert Committee (2013) of MoPR dealt with:
o: Panchayats for delivery of public services
new.x: The 2013 V. Ramachandran Expert Committee dealt with panchayats for delivery of public services; the Ombudsman idea came from the Second ARC.

new.s: Which ECI app lets citizens report Model Code of Conduct and expenditure violations with time-stamped evidence?
new.x: cVIGIL lets citizens report MCC and expenditure violations with time-stamped evidence; status is given within 100 minutes.

new.s: The Saksham-ECI app is meant mainly to help:
new.x: Saksham-ECI, developed with the Department of Empowerment of PwDs, gives registration and polling help to persons with disabilities.

new.s: Which of the following ECI app – purpose pairs is correctly matched?
o: cVIGIL – help for persons with disabilities
SVEEP – home voting for voters above 85
new.x: The Voter Helpline uses toll-free 1950; cVIGIL is for MCC violations, Saksham-ECI for PwDs and SVEEP for voter education.

new.s: The home-voting facility is available to voters above the age of:
new.x: Home voting is for voters above 85 and PwDs with 40% benchmark disability.

new.s: In April 2019, the Supreme Court raised VVPAT slip verification to how many randomly selected EVMs per Assembly segment?
new.x: On 8 April 2019 the SC raised verification from one to five randomly selected EVMs-VVPATs per Assembly segment.

new.s: In ADR v. ECI (April 2024), symbol loading units are to be sealed and kept in the strong room for how many days after results?
new.x: The SC rejected 100% VVPAT verification and ordered symbol loading units sealed for 45 days after results.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the ADR v. ECI judgment (26 April 2024):
1. It ordered 100% VVPAT verification.
2. A verification request must be made within 7 days of results, at the candidate's cost.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Only statement 2 is correct; the Supreme Court rejected the demand for 100% VVPAT verification.

new.s: Under Section 57 of the RPA 1951, a poll disrupted by riot or open violence may be adjourned by the:
new.x: Section 57 lets the Presiding or Returning Officer adjourn the poll; the adjourned poll resumes with ECI approval.

new.s: If an EVM is unlawfully taken away or tampered with, the ECI may declare the poll void and order a fresh poll under RPA 1951 Section:
new.x: Section 58 covers EVMs or ballot boxes taken, destroyed, lost or tampered with; Section 57 covers adjournment and 58A booth capturing.

new.s: Which of the following RPA 1951 section – situation pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Section 58A deals with booth capturing; Section 57 with riot or calamity and Section 58 with EVMs taken or tampered with.

new.s: Disputes relating to the election of the President and Vice-President are decided by the:
new.x: Under Article 71, President and Vice-President election disputes go to the Supreme Court.

new.s: The election of which of the following is conducted by the Election Commission of India?
o: Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha
new.x: The ECI conducts the Vice-President's election; presiding officers of the Houses are chosen by their own Houses.

new.s: The Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha are chosen:
o: By the Lok Sabha itself under Article 93
new.x: Under Article 93 the Lok Sabha itself chooses its Speaker and Deputy Speaker; the ECI has no role.

new.s: The Chief Electoral Officer of a State is provided for under:
new.x: The CEO rests on Section 13A of the RPA 1950 and is not a constitutional authority.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Chief Electoral Officer of a State?
o: The ECI appoints the CEO in consultation with the State Government
The CEO is a constitutional authority
The CEO can be removed by the ECI
The CEO oversees Lok Sabha and Assembly polls under ECI control
new.x: The Chief Electoral Officer is a statutory officer under Section 13A of the RPA 1950, not a constitutional authority.

new.s: The ECI advises the President on the disqualification of Members of Parliament under Article:
new.x: Article 103 covers ECI advice to the President on MPs; Article 192 covers advice to the Governor on MLAs.

new.s: Disqualification on grounds of defection under the Tenth Schedule is decided by the:
new.x: Anti-defection cases go to the Speaker or Chairman, not the ECI.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a function of the Election Commission of India?
o: Recommending President's Rule in a State
Advising the Governor on disqualification of MLAs
new.x: Recommending President's Rule is not an ECI function; the others are its administrative, quasi-judicial and advisory roles.

new.s: Assam's delimitation, effective August 2023, was carried out by the:
o: Delimitation Commission under Justice Ranjana Desai
new.x: The ECI itself delimited Assam; the J&K delimitation of 2022 was done by a Commission under Justice Ranjana Desai.

new.s: The first Sukumar Sen Memorial Lecture of the ECI (23 January 2020) was delivered by:
new.x: The lecture series was announced in 2019, and Pranab Mukherjee gave the first lecture on 23 January 2020.

new.s: T.N. Seshan, whose tenure (1990-96) is known as the reform era, was India's:
new.x: T.N. Seshan was the 10th CEC, from 12 December 1990 to 11 December 1996.

new.s: Under the CEC and Other ECs Act, 2023, the Search Committee shortlists how many names?
new.x: The Search Committee, headed by the Law Minister with two Secretary-rank members, shortlists five names.

new.s: The CEC and Other ECs Act, 2023 (Act No. 49 of 2023) replaced the earlier Act of:
new.x: The 2023 Act replaced the 1991 Act on the service conditions of the CEC and ECs.

new.s: Regional Commissioners may be appointed by the President after consulting the:
new.x: The President may appoint Regional Commissioners after consulting the Election Commission.
